subject: Customer impact brief + adaptive demo runbook for Atlas Bank event
messages:
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Leah Thompson <leah.thompson@atlasbank.com>
Cc: Atlas Bank Events <events@atlasbank.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Customer impact brief + adaptive demo runbook for Atlas Bank event

Team / Leah,

Quick summary: Atlas invited us to present a 20-minute spotlight at their Innovation Day on 2027-02-03. The ask from their side is an executive one-pager (two-sided) plus a live 12-15 minute demo that can flex between a cost-savings narrative and a compliance/security narrative depending on the audience.

I attached two working files: a draft one-pager and an adaptive demo runbook. Please review with the following in mind:
- One-pager: crisp headline, 3 bullets on customer impact (latency, cost, reliability), one customer quote placeholder, and a clear CTA for post-event follow-up.
- Demo runbook: primary flow (cost-savings) + fallback branch (compliance-focused), cue cards for transitions, 3 quick recovery lines if something fails, and an intro script for the MC.

Immediate asks (can you please):
- Soojin: tighten the slide language and remove benchmarking jargon (audience is execs). Add a short "prompt recipe" callout that highlights reproducibility.
- Marissa: supply a short customer quote we can use as a placeholder, and a 1-paragraph case summary for the one-pager.
- Ben: confirm the 2-minute hands-on demo clip (video) will be ready or whether we should run live only.
- Leah / Atlas Events: can you confirm whether the audience will skew to security leadership or finance execs? That will drive which demo branch we prioritize.

Attachments: 20270110-Atlas-Impact-OnePager-v1.pdf; adaptive-demo-runbook-v2.docx

I can schedule a 30-minute rehearsal window on Tue 2027-01-12 afternoon — propose 3:00pm PST; please flag conflicts.

Thanks,
Nikhil Sharma
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ninhil_sharma@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192
https://redwood.inference

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Leah Thompson <leah.thompson@atlasbank.com>, Atlas Bank Events <events@atlasbank.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Jan 2027 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Customer impact brief + adaptive demo runbook for Atlas Bank event

On Mon, Jan 10, 2027 at 09:12 AM Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team / Leah,
> 
> Quick summary: Atlas invited us to present a 20-minute spotlight at their Innovation Day on 2027-02-03.

Thanks for the clear asks — a few quick edits from my side after a first pass of the one-pager and runbook:
- One-pager headline: change to "Real-world inference: predictable latency, lower op cost" (shorter).
- Replace the technical metric row with a simple 3-number strip: "Avg latency, 95th pct latency, % cost saved (pilot)" — leave numbers blank until we confirm with Atlas.
- Demo script: add a 10-second "why it matters" opener for execs, then the customer vignette, then the live demo.
- Remove the detailed GPU/quantization table — not audience-appropriate. Move to an appendix doc that we can hand to technical attendees.

I added line-level edit comments in the Drive link (see related links). I also sketched a 30-second "recovery line" in the runbook when a live model times out: "We have a cached response we can show while we isolate the environment — this is planned behavior to keep demos smooth."

I can join the rehearsal at 3:00pm PST on Jan 12.

—So
Soojin Lee
Sr. DevRel | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Leah Thompson <leah.thompson@atlasbank.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Jan 2027 11:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Customer impact brief + adaptive demo runbook for Atlas Bank event

On Mon, Jan 10, 2027 at 10:05 AM Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks for the clear asks — a few quick edits from my side...

Looping in a short customer quote that could work as a placeholder — we should confirm with the Atlas customer success lead before finalizing: 
"Working with Redwood Inference helped our pilot stabilize latency spikes and gave us predictable budgeting for inference costs."

Suggested one-pager copy (short):
- Problem: scaling inference added unpredictable cost and latency to our conversational features.
- Solution: Redwood Inference provided a unified serving runtime with caching and routing controls.
- Impact (pilot): reduced 95th pct latency, smoother experiences, and a single-pane view for operator cost.

I've attached a text snippet (customer-quote-1216.txt) with a cleaned quote and suggested attribution line (placeholder). Also: recommend a small boxed CTA: "Request a 15-minute pilot review" with a Calendly link.

Marissa Cole
Field Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Leah Thompson <leah.thompson@atlasbank.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Jan 2027 08:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Customer impact brief + adaptive demo runbook for Atlas Bank event

Hi Nikhil / team,

Thanks for sending these over. A couple of quick notes from our side:
- Audience: it's split — about ~60% finance/ops and ~40% security/compliance leaders. Please prioritize the cost-savings narrative but have the compliance branch ready if the MC leans that way.
- Sensitive data: please remove the sample log snippet on page 2 of the runbook — it references sample IDs that could be misinterpreted as customer PII. Replace with an aggregated metric visual (avg latency by region).
- Quote: happy to provide a vetted line from our pilot, but we need to run it through legal. I'll coordinate and circle back by Friday.

We can do a final 20-minute run-through on Feb 2 between 11:00-13:00 EST — if you can propose one 20-min slot, I'll lock it in.

Leah Thompson
Director, Innovation Programs | Atlas Bank
leah.thompson@atlasbank.com

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
To: Leah Thompson <leah.thompson@atlasbank.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 15:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Customer impact brief + adaptive demo runbook for Atlas Bank event

Thanks all — quick updates and confirmation:

1) Removed the sample log snippet and replaced it with an "avg latency by region" chart (see updated one-pager v1.1).
2) Customer quote: noted — Leah please send when legal clears. We'll keep the placeholder until then.
3) Rehearsal: booked Feb 2 at 11:30am EST (20 minutes). Calendar invite sent to the above distribution; meeting link: https://meet.google.com/rw-inference-atlas-run
4) Attachments: uploaded a new runbook v2 (adaptive-demo-runbook-v2.docx) with the compliance branch prioritized as branch B and explicit recovery lines for cached responses. Also updated the one-pager filename to 20270110-Atlas-Impact-OnePager-v1.1.pdf

Ben — please confirm whether you'll supply the 2-minute clip by Jan 28 or whether we should plan a live-only segment. If live-only, we will script a short fallback video snippet to show if needed.

Appreciate the quick turn here. Team — I'll lock final copy by Jan 20 and send the rehearsal rubric ahead of Feb 2.

Cheers,
Nikhil Sharma
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
